name: dashild
description: The application admin layer for Next.js

scripts.pack:all: rm -rf artifacts && mkdir -p artifacts && pnpm --filter @dashild/core pack --pack-destination artifacts && pnpm --filter @dashild/prisma pack --pack-destination artifacts && pnpm --filter @dashild/admin pack --pack-destination artifacts && pnpm --filter @dashild/cli pack --pack-destination artifacts && pnpm --filter create-dashild pack --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.release:alpha: pnpm clean && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @dashild/core publish --tag alpha --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @dashild/prisma publish --tag alpha --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @dashild/admin publish --tag alpha --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter @dashild/cli publish --tag alpha --access public --no-git-checks
